name: Native CAPI / Google
job: Fire native Meta CAPI and Google conversion events on Sales pipeline Booked and Won, sale_type=new only. Does not fire on the clinic pipelines.

named_steps.name: TRIGGER: Sales pipeline Booked or Won (sale_type=new)
named_steps.comment: Sole conversion trigger. Must not fire on clinic pipelines. Must not fire on renewals.

named_steps.name: IF-ELSE: Guard sale_type=new and pipeline=Sales Lead to Close
named_steps.comment: Belt-and-suspenders guard so a mis-tagged opp cannot fire conversions.

named_steps.name: WEBHOOK: Native Meta CAPI Lead (Booked branch)
named_steps.comment: Native GHL Meta CAPI action. Must not include monetaryValue in payload beyond native mapping.

named_steps.name: WEBHOOK: Native Meta CAPI Purchase (Won branch)
named_steps.comment: Native GHL Meta CAPI action for Won.

named_steps.name: WEBHOOK: Native Google Ads conversion (Won branch)
ADD-TAG: v2_conv_won_new (Won branch)
named_steps.comment: Audit tag for Won + new only.
